tensions: DATA INTEGRITY FLAG: the position table's cost bases sum to $1,418.32, not the $1,231 total the config asserts — a $187 gap. The real decision — which of ADA, LINK, or NEAR funds the next position — is being deferred, not made.

opening.text: BTC $76,982, dominance 58.8%, F&G 61 (Greed). Total cap $2.63T, down 3.5% on the day. The 30-day tape is still a recovery rally — BTC +23%, ETH +33.5%, NEAR +44%, ZEC +122% — but the 7-day window has rolled over almost everywhere. That is the honest read: we are cooling inside an uptrend, not reversing out of one. Buying power is $7.14, so today's scan is observation, not action.

Book is $1,409.52 crypto plus $7.14 cash. Winners: ZEC $939.05 to $1,087.34 (+14.7%, 10 days), SOL $92.80 to $100.26 (+8.0%, 28 days), LTC $52.01 to $54.10 (+4.0%, 9 days), DOT $1.00 to $1.007 (+0.4%). Losers: NEAR $2.45 to $2.315 (-5.5%), LINK $11.73 to $11.28 (-3.8%), ADA $0.2116 to $0.2056 (-3.7%). Seven positions, seven HOLDs. Nothing tripped a broken-thesis sell.

LINK is the ugliest chart in the book: -12.8% over seven days, the worst of the seven, and it has given back most of a +27% month. But the thesis was never a seven-day thesis — oracle infrastructure and CCIP adoption do not reprice weekly. LTC is the only coin green on 24 hours (+1.3%), DOT the only one green on seven days (+5.5%). That quiet strength from the two least exciting names is the tell that this is rotation, not exit.

ZEC is the position that will test the rules. Up 122% in 30 days, now -10.5% in seven. Every instinct says lock it in. The mandate says do not trim, ride the wave, hold for 100x. A parabola digesting is not a parabola breaking, and the only thing selling here guarantees is that we are out if it runs again. Holding. ADA is the real watch item — weakest 30-day at +15.8%, underperforming the whole book with no catalyst. Not a sell today, but the first name to question when cash returns.
